name: cursor-cost-tracker
description: Status bar spend + Today. Statistics: burn rate, Pro meters, Coding stats (AI vs git). Blocking critical alert on huge queries. Monthly forecast, Optimize locally, 10 UI languages.
author: Łukasz Zileiński

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Reads the local Cursor session and usage APIs; does not execute workspace code.

cursorCost.language.markdownDescription: Interface language for the Last N panel, status bar, and toasts. **English** is the default. Independent of the VS Code / Cursor display language.

cursorCost.pollIntervalMinutes.markdownDescription: How often to refresh Current and Today from Cursor usage APIs (1-60 minutes). Default is 1.

cursorCost.showStatusBar.markdownDescription: Show Current, Today, recent queries, and Refresh on the status bar.

cursorCost.showToday.markdownDescription: Show the Today status bar item. Hidden automatically on unlimited plans or when daily usage cannot be loaded.

cursorCost.minimalMode.markdownDescription: Show only **Current** on the status bar (hide Today, recent queries, and extra chips). Refresh stays visible.

cursorCost.recentQueryCount.markdownDescription: How many newest queries to show as separate status bar items (1–10). Default is 3.

cursorCost.spikeTokenThreshold.markdownDescription: Show `!` when a query uses at least this many tokens. Settings tab edits this in **k** (1k = 1,000 tokens; step 100k). Default is 1,000,000 (1000k).

cursorCost.showSpikeWarning.markdownDescription: Show `!` and green/red colors on the status bar and in the query table. When off, there are no exclamation marks and no status colors.

cursorCost.showCriticalAlert.markdownDescription: Show a blocking dialog when the **newest** query reaches the critical token or dollar threshold. Each query is shown once. Independent of the status-bar `!` warning.

cursorCost.criticalTokenThreshold.markdownDescription: Blocking alert when the newest query uses at least this many tokens (default **10,000,000**). Settings tab edits this in **k** (10000 = 10M tokens). Either this or the dollar threshold is enough.

cursorCost.criticalCostUsdThreshold.markdownDescription: Blocking alert when the newest query costs at least this many US dollars (default **5**). Either this or the token threshold is enough.

cursorCost.burnRateGuard.markdownDescription: Track spend in a short live window (default 10 minutes) on Statistics. When on, a fast burst can tint Today and show a non-blocking toast. Dollar toasts need billed `costUsd` — included Pro events at $0 still show token throughput on the card.

cursorCost.burnRateWindowMinutes.markdownDescription: How many minutes of recent queries to sum for Burn Rate Guard (2–60). Default is **10**. The right edge is now, so the rate falls as rows age out.

cursorCost.burnRateWarningUsd.markdownDescription: Non-blocking warning toast when window spend reaches this many US dollars (default **2**). Needs at least `burnRateMinQueries` requests in the window.

cursorCost.burnRateCriticalUsd.markdownDescription: Non-blocking critical toast when window spend reaches this many US dollars (default **5**). Never below the warning amount. Does **not** stop Cursor.

cursorCost.burnRateMinQueries.markdownDescription: Minimum requests in the live window before Burn Rate Guard can warn (default **2**). A single expensive query stays the last-query critical alert.

cursorCost.burnRateWarningToast.markdownDescription: Show a non-blocking warning toast when window spend reaches the warning dollar threshold.

cursorCost.burnRateCriticalToast.markdownDescription: Show a non-blocking error toast when window spend reaches the critical dollar threshold. Still not a blocking modal.

cursorCost.codeLinesInsight.markdownDescription: Show **Coding stats** on Statistics and Charts: git insertions on `main`/`master` vs AI composer lines for this repo (`landed / AI = %`), plus Cursor dashboard Lines Edited (**All on Cursor**). Not which AI lines survived review.

cursorCost.historyLimit.markdownDescription: How many newest queries to load (100–10,000). Default is 1,000. Also on the Settings tab as **Show last**. Ignored when **From date** is set.

cursorCost.historyFromDate.markdownDescription: Load every query from this local calendar day (`YYYY-MM-DD`) through today, instead of **Show last**. Empty uses Last N. Example: `2026-09-01` for the start of September. Caps at 10,000.

cursorCost.budgetDayBasis.markdownDescription: How to spread the remaining cycle into a daily budget and month forecast. **Working days** (default) uses Mon–Fri only. **Calendar days** uses every day in the month (e.g. 30 in September instead of ~22 weekdays).
enumDescriptions: Mon–Fri only, including today when today is a weekday (default).
Every calendar day in the month, including weekends.

cursorCost.optimizeDepth.markdownDescription: How thorough the **Optimize** tab prompt is. **Balanced** (default) proposes rules and a savings estimate. **Quick** is shorter. **Deep** asks for a full playbook and projected token/$ savings file.
enumDescriptions: Short findings and three process tips.
Full playbook, rule drafts, and per-cluster savings.

cursorCost.okColor.markdownDescription: Status color for the good state (under cap, no spike). The default follows the workbench: mint on dark themes, a darker green on light themes.

cursorCost.warnColor.markdownDescription: Status color for warnings (at/over cap or a token spike). The default follows the workbench: coral on dark themes, a darker red on light themes.
